summaryZh: FAPPG 研究等离子体和流体的非线性、非平衡动力学，重点涉及湍流、反常输运和自组织。团队使用数学模型与计算模拟，研究实验室及宇宙等离子体并支持磁约束聚变研究。
researchQuestions: 等离子体如何运动，并与磁场及边界相互作用？
等离子体如何在不同尺度上演化？
topics: 等离子体与流体动力学

evidence.quote: Fusion and Astrophysical Plasma Physics Group (FAPPG)
our research focuses on nonlinear and non-equilibrium dynamics of magnetized and neutral fluids
anomalous transport, basic and applied plasma turbulence theory, and the dynamics of plasma self-organization.
We use mathematical models and computer simulations
As part of the Center for Astrophysics and Space Sciences at UC San Diego
We use mathematical models and computer simulations to explain how plasmas move, interact with magnetic fields and boundaries, and evolve on various scales.
